Position: ICT Support Technician
Type: Full-time
Employer: The Trustee for Patel Family Trust (Robust IT Services)
Location: South Geelong VIC 3220
Salary: $80,000 p/a
About the Business
Robust IT Services is a dynamic and growing IT solutions provider based in South Geelong, specialising in managed IT services, infrastructure design, cloud solutions, network security, vulnerability testing, data security, and comprehensive business IT support. With a strong focus on delivering responsive, reliable, and forward-thinking technological solutions, the company has built a solid reputation for helping businesses of all sizes optimise their IT environments, mitigate risks, and drive operational success. Guided by values of innovation, quality, professionalism, and customer-centric service, Robust IT fosters a collaborative, supportive workplace culture where team members are encouraged to solve challenges, continuously develop their skills, and contribute to meaningful client outcomes in a fast-paced yet balanced environment.
About the Position
The ICT Support Technician plays a key hands-on role within Robust IT Services by providing day-to-day technical support to end-users and clients, diagnosing and resolving hardware, software, and network issues, and ensuring the reliable operation of IT systems and infrastructure. This position is essential for maintaining high service standards, minimising downtime, and delivering excellent customer support across the company’s internal operations and client environments.
Key Responsibilities
Provide timely technical support and assistance to end-users, diagnosing and resolving hardware, software, network, and peripheral issues.
Install, configure, maintain, and upgrade computer systems, operating systems, applications, and network components.
Respond to user inquiries about IT problems and provide clear guidance and solutions.
Manage user accounts, permissions, and access in systems such as Active Directory and Microsoft 365.
Perform regular system backups, updates, patches, and basic security maintenance.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues with printers, mobile devices, and other peripherals.
Maintain accurate documentation of support activities, procedures, and asset records.
Collaborate with the team on IT projects, system improvements, and client support initiatives.
Ensure compliance with service level agreements and quality standards.
Requirements
Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
Diploma in Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
Minimum 1 year of experience in IT support, helpdesk, or a similar technical role.
Strong technical skills in troubleshooting hardware and software issues, Microsoft environments (including Office 365 and Active Directory), networking fundamentals, and remote support tools.
Excellent customer service, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users.
Ability to work independently and as part of a small team in a fast-paced environment.
How to Apply
To apply, applicants must submit their resume with a valid email address through this online portal.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Next Gen Talent
Company: Dharma Bhakti Group Pty Ltd t/a Sunrise Custom Homes
Position Title: Architectural Draftsperson
Location: Adelaide, South Australia, 3061
Salary: AUD 79,500 to 82,000 + Super

About the Business:
Sunrise Custom Homes are Adelaide’s trusted custom home builders. They specialise in fully customisable homes and work closely with each client to bring their vision to life. Whether you’re building your first home or creating an investment property, their expertise and passion ensure your dream becomes a reality.

About the Role:
They are seeking a skilled and motivated Architectural Draftsperson to join their team. This hands-on position requires strong technical capability in drafting and documentation, along with a commitment to accuracy and high-quality design outcomes. The ideal candidate will be proficient in industry-standard drafting software and confident in reading, interpreting, and producing detailed architectural drawings. You’ll play a key role in transforming concepts into build-ready documentation, contributing directly to the delivery of custom homes.

Minimum Requirements:
Diploma or Advanced Diploma in Building Design, Architectural Drafting, Building Design Technology or a related discipline, or an equivalent qualification.
Minimum 1–3 years' experience in architectural drafting or building design within Australian residential construction projects.

Key Responsibilities:
Prepare detailed architectural drawings, construction documentation and working drawings for residential dwellings, custom homes, renovations and property development projects using CAD and Revit software.
Develop concept drawings, floor plans, elevations, sections and detailed construction documentation based on client requirements, architectural designs and engineering specifications.
Produce accurate working drawings in accordance with the National Construction Code (NCC), relevant Australian Standards and local council planning requirements.
Prepare detailed documentation including structural layouts, site plans, floor plans, roof plans, drainage layouts, service layouts and construction details for residential projects.
Modify and customise existing home designs and floor plans to suit client preferences, site conditions, budget requirements and regulatory requirements.
Coordinate drawings and documentation with architects, engineers, building designers, surveyors, certifiers, energy assessors, consultants, builders and project managers to ensure design accuracy and project consistency.
Liaise with clients and project stakeholders to gather project information and translate design concepts into accurate technical drawings.
Prepare documentation required for Development Applications (DA), Planning Approvals, Building Approvals, Council submissions and other statutory approval processes.
Review architectural, structural and engineering drawings to identify inconsistencies, drafting errors and construction issues prior to project commencement.
Amend, revise and update drawings based on client feedback, council requirements, consultant recommendations, engineering input and design changes throughout the design and construction process.
Assist with project coordination, planning approvals and construction documentation throughout all stages of residential projects.
Prepare schedules for doors, windows, finishes, fixtures and fittings to support construction documentation and procurement.
Assist in preparing material quantities, preliminary cost estimates and design documentation for tendering and project planning purposes.
Conduct site measurements and inspections where required to verify existing conditions and ensure drafting accuracy for renovations, custom homes and development projects.
Collaborate with construction supervisors, site teams and project managers to resolve design-related queries during construction and issue updated documentation where required.
Maintain accurate electronic records of drawings, revisions, project documentation and version control using the company's document management systems.
Research and apply current building regulations, planning policies, residential construction methods and sustainable design principles to ensure ongoing compliance and improve project outcomes.

Essential Skills
Proficient in CAD and Revit software for producing accurate architectural drawings and construction documentation.
Strong understanding of residential construction methods, detailing, building systems and construction processes.
Thorough knowledge of the National Construction Code (NCC), Australian Standards and local council planning requirements.
Ability to interpret architectural drawings, engineering plans, technical specifications and consultant documentation.
Strong attention to detail with the ability to prepare accurate, compliant and high-quality documentation.
Excellent communication and coordination skills with the ability to work effectively with clients, engineers, consultants, builders, site teams and project managers.
Strong organisational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Sound problem-solving skills and the ability to identify and resolve drafting and design issues throughout project delivery.

How to Apply:
To apply for this position, please email your resume to info@nextgentalent.com.au. Please note that only short-listed candidates will be contacted, and your application will be treated as strictly confidential

result.description:
Employer:	Royal 3PL Pty Ltd t/a Northedge Cabinets and Cladding
Position: 	Office Manager 
Salary: 	       $76,000 – $85,000 Plus Superannuation
Location: 	36 Highlander Dr. Craigieburn VIC 3064
Mode: 		Full-Time
Experience:	1 year experience
Royal 3PL Pty Ltd trading as Northedge Cabinets and Cladding, is an Australian-owned company specialising in the design, manufacture, supply, and installation of premium cabinetry and architectural cladding solutions. The company delivers high-quality products and services to residential, commercial, and multi-unit developments across Australia, working closely with builders, developers, architects, designers, and private clients.
Northedge Cabinets and Cladding provides customised joinery and cabinetry solutions for kitchens, bathrooms, wardrobes, laundries, offices, and other interior spaces, together with innovative cladding systems that enhance the functionality and visual appeal of modern buildings. The company is committed to delivering tailored solutions that meet each client's design requirements while maintaining exceptional standards of workmanship, quality, and customer service.
The business manages projects from initial consultation and design through to manufacturing, project coordination, delivery, and installation. By integrating skilled craftsmanship with efficient project management and modern manufacturing techniques, Northedge Cabinets and Cladding ensures projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the highest industry standards.
As the company continues to expand its operations and undertake an increasing number of residential and commercial projects, it has experienced significant growth in its administrative and operational requirements. This growth has created the need for dedicated management of office operations, customer communications, project administration, supplier coordination, procurement activities, and internal business processes.
To support the continued expansion of the business, Royal 3PL Pty Ltd requires a skilled Office Manager to oversee the company's administrative functions, coordinate office operations, streamline internal processes, and provide essential support to management, production, installation teams, suppliers, and clients. The position plays a critical role in ensuring the efficient day-to-day operation of the business while enabling the company to maintain its high standards of service delivery and support its future growth objectives.
Key Responsibilities:

•	Coordinate the day-to-day administrative operations of the office to ensure efficient workflow and business continuity.
•	Develop, implement and maintain office procedures, administrative systems and record management processes to improve operational efficiency.
•	Coordinate incoming customer enquiries, prepare quotations, maintain job files and ensure project documentation is complete and up to date.
•	Liaise with clients, builders, suppliers and subcontractors regarding project schedules, material deliveries, installation dates and administrative requirements.
•	Prepare and process purchase orders, supplier invoices, customer invoices and related administrative documentation.
•	Monitor office expenditure, maintain financial records and assist management with budget tracking and monthly administrative reports.
•	Coordinate procurement of office supplies and monitor stock of administrative and operational consumables.
•	Maintain accurate records of contracts, supplier agreements, project documentation and company compliance documents.
•	Coordinate staff rosters, leave records, timesheets and other human resources administration activities.
•	Ensure office operations comply with company policies, workplace health and safety procedures and relevant legislative requirements.
•	Prepare regular administrative and operational reports for management to support business planning and decision-making.
•	Identify opportunities to improve office procedures and implement administrative process improvements to enhance productivity and customer service.
•	Provide administrative support to senior management and coordinate communication between office staff, production personnel and installation teams to ensure projects progress efficiently.
	
To be successful in this role, you must have:

•	A relevant qualification in Business Administration, Management, Office Administration, or a related discipline, or equivalent industry experience.
•	At least one year of relevant experience in an office management, administration, or operations coordination role (or as otherwise required under the relevant visa or company policy).
•	Strong knowledge of office administration procedures, document management, and business operations.
•	Excellent organisational and time management skills with the ability to prioritise multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
•	Demonstrated leadership and supervisory skills with the ability to coordinate and support administrative staff.
